environment_enforcement: The exact outer recipe is invoked through env -i with only the listed variables. Bubblewrap preserves the caller's repository working directory. The checker likewise supplies a minimal environment to every local Git, Lake, Lean, and Bubblewrap subprocess and checks material executable digests.
network_enforcement: The entire release checker runs inside bubblewrap --unshare-net with a read-only host root and writable private /tmp. Lean elaboration/check subprocesses inherit that denied network namespace and write only fresh temporary target outputs. The existing shared warm dependency cache still makes this explicitly nonrelease evidence.
scope_boundary: Reconciles the frozen 14-obligation inventory and current authority, then performs a current network-isolated trust-zero warm-cache replay of the existing exact proof root and same-route differential root. It does not reconcile the quotient proof into the frozen direct-T2 graph, make the stale predecessor recipe current, accept any receipt, or supply H0, R0, AUDIT-Z, cold/offline release evidence, independent verification, THEOREM-Z, release, or master acceptance.
